title: 第9章 银月城的阴影第10章 圣痕与深渊
slug: 黯潮纪元异世界的崛起
lines: 清晨的光从医疗所的窗缝漏进来，陈默刚把绷带缠好，门就被推开了。
三个人。领头的是个穿白袍的老者，胸口的圣徽比科尔曼的大三倍，纯金镶边。身后跟着两个全副武装的圣殿骑士，剑柄上的蓝宝石在晨光里泛着冷光。
“雷诺·艾德伍德骑士。”老者的声音很轻，但每个字都像钉子钉进木头里，“我是审判官伊格纳修斯，需要你回答几个问题。”
陈默的手指停在绷带结上。他能感觉到指尖下棉布的粗糙纹理，还有昨夜圣光灼烧后皮肤残留的刺痛。
“请坐。”
伊格纳修斯没坐。他走到窗边，伸手摸了下窗框——那里有昨夜圣光蔓延时留下的焦痕。指尖触到焦痕的瞬间，他缩回手，像被烫到一样。
“你能引导圣光。”这不是疑问句。
“是的。”
“什么时候开始的？在哪个节点？当时周围有什么异常？”
三个问题连珠炮般砸过来。陈默想起科尔曼的警告——教廷的人，一个字都不要多说。
“三天前，在城墙上，当时有一波黯潮冲击。”他挑了最安全的答案，“科尔曼副团长在场。”
伊格纳修斯转过身，盯着他看了五秒。那双眼睛是灰色的，像蒙了层雾，雾后面有什么东西在翻涌。
“你知道‘异界行者’这个词吗？”
陈默的心脏猛地收缩了一下。
“不知道。”
“旧日纪元的文献里提到过。”伊格纳修斯说得很慢，像在咀嚼每个字，“穿越位面的人，灵魂不属于这个世界。他们能引导不属于这个位面的力量——比如圣光。”
他顿了顿，目光落在陈默的瞳孔上。
“埃尔德兰的圣光，本该只属于埃尔德兰的子民。”
房间里安静得能听见灰尘落地的声音。陈默感觉后颈的汗毛竖了起来——就像在三星堆那个地下墓室里，第一次听到青铜面具发出声音时的感觉。他握紧拳头，指甲掐进掌心。
“我不明白您在说什么。”
伊格纳修斯没有追问。他从袍子里取出一张羊皮纸，展开。上面画着一个螺旋图案——和阿尔德里奇留在屋顶的那个一模一样。
“认识这个吗？”
陈默盯着那个图案，喉咙发干。他认识。太认识了。三星堆青铜面具的底部，刻着同样的螺旋。那个面具现在还在他的背包里，穿越时一起带过来的。
“不认识。”
伊格纳修斯把羊皮纸收起来，动作很慢，像在给陈默时间改变主意。
“你最好真的不认识。”他说，“阿尔德里奇大法师把自己关在塔里之前，用血在墙上画了这个图案。三天后，他的塔就变成了‘门’。”
他走向门口，在门框边停下，没有回头。
“银月城的圣光失控只是开始。骑士，你身上有股不属于这个世界的气息。我劝你——在教廷正式介入之前，想清楚自己要站在哪一边。”
门关上了。脚步声远去。
陈默坐在床边，发现自己握紧的拳头上，指甲已经掐进肉里。掌心有四个血痕，正慢慢渗出血珠。
上午的编队命令来得很快。
content_en:
The early morning light filtered in through the window of the medical clinic. As soon as Chen Mo wrapped the bandage, the door was pushed open.
Three people. The leader was an old man in white robes. The holy symbol on his chest was three times larger than Coleman's, and was trimmed with pure gold. Behind them were two fully armed Templars, the sapphires on their sword hilts glowing coldly in the morning light.
"Knight Renault Edwood." The old man's voice was very soft, but every word was like nails driven into wood. "I am Judge Ignatius. I need you to answer a few questions."
Chen Mo's fingers stopped on the bandage knot. He could feel the rough texture of the cotton under his fingertips, and the lingering sting on his skin after last night's holy light burned it.
"Please take a seat."
Ignatius did not sit down. He walked to the window and reached out to touch the window frame - there were scorch marks left when the holy light spread last night. The moment his fingertips touched the burn mark, he retracted his hand as if he had been burned.
"You can guide the Holy Light." This is not a question.
"Yes."
"When did it start? At which point? What were the abnormalities around that time?"
Three questions came at me like a barrage. Chen Mo remembered Coleman's warning - people from the Holy See should not say a word more.
"Three days ago, on the city wall, there was a wave of darkness." He chose the safest answer, "Deputy Commander Coleman was present."
Ignatius turned and stared at him for five seconds. Those eyes were gray, as if covered with a layer of fog, and something was surging behind the fog.
"Do you know the term 'alien traveler'?"
Chen Mo's heart contracted suddenly.
"I don't know."
"It is mentioned in the documents of the old era." Ignatius said slowly, as if chewing every word, "The souls of people who travel through the plane do not belong to this world. They can guide powers that do not belong to this plane - such as the Holy Light."
He paused and his eyes fell on Chen Mo's pupils.
"The Holy Light of Eldran should only belong to the people of Eldran."
The room was so quiet that you could hear the dust falling to the floor. Chen Mo felt the hairs on the back of his neck stand up - just like the feeling when he first heard the sound of the bronze mask in the underground tomb in Sanxingdui. He clenched his fists and dug his nails into his palms.
"I don't know what you're talking about."
Ignatius didn't ask. He took a piece of parchment from his robe and unfolded it. Painted on it was a spiral pattern—exactly the same as the one Aldridge left on the roof.
"Do you know this?"
Chen Mo stared at the pattern, his throat going dry. He knows. So familiar. The same spiral is engraved on the bottom of the Sanxingdui bronze mask. The mask is still in his backpack, he brought it with him when he traveled through time.
"I don't know."
Ignatius put the parchment away very slowly, as if giving Chen Mo time to change his mind.
"It's better that you really don't know it." He said, "Arch Mage Aldrich drew this pattern on the wall with blood before he locked himself in the tower. Three days later, his tower became a 'door'."
He walked towards the door and stopped at the door frame without looking back.
"The runaway Holy Light in Silvermoon City is just the beginning. Knight, you have an aura that does not belong to this world. I advise you - before the Holy See officially intervenes, think clearly about which side you want to stand on."
The door is closed. The footsteps fade away.
Chen Mo sat on the edge of the bed and found that his nails had dug into the flesh of his clenched fists. There are four blood marks on the palm, and blood is slowly oozing out.
***
The morning formation orders came quickly.
